title: A Bengaluru satellite startup just raised $100 million to build more of them
sources: SpaceNews, September 2026 - Pixxel raises $100 million to expand satellite production across India and US
Pixxel, September 2026 - Pixxel raises $100 million in Series C funding to build the infrastructure for a changing planet
caption:
Six hyperspectral satellites are already in orbit, built by one Bengaluru company. It just raised $100 million to build a lot more.

Pixxel's Series C round, announced this September and led by Temasek and Seraphim, brings total funding to $195 million. Founded in 2019, the company plans to use the funds for more sensing satellites, its Aurora software platform, sovereign Earth-observation systems and a new satellite manufacturing facility in the US alongside its Bengaluru operations.

A satellite company scaling up isn't just a bigger fleet - it's more of the planet becoming visible, in more detail, to whoever needs to see it.
